text: In June 2026 Christopher Wynne, the head of Papa John's in Russia, left the founders: his 75% share in OOO 'Pi Dzhey Franchizing Rus' passed to the company itself; the remaining 25% belongs to OOO 'Pi Dzhey Eurasia', controlled by the Cyprus company PJ Western Retail Investments Limited.
short: After Christopher Wynne exited in June 2026, 75% of Papa John's Russia sits with the company itself and 25% with PJ Western's Cyprus-controlled structure.

source.name: TAdviser: Папа Джонс (Papa Johns) company profile
source.note: TAdviser (registered Russian media outlet) reports the June 2026 EGRUL register changes, citing reporting on the register.
source.quote: Доля 75%, которой владел Кристофер Уинн в ООО «Пи Джей франчайзинг рус» перешла к самому обществу. Оставшиеся 25% принадлежат ООО «Пи Джей Евразия»
